name: Dynamic Data Search
author: iflairwebtechnologies

sections.description:
Dynamic Data Search is a powerful, lightweight, and fully customizable AJAX search plugin for WordPress.

Search results appear instantly while typing — no page reloads and no performance lag.

It supports posts, pages, custom post types, taxonomies, WooCommerce products, and even Gutenberg (FSE) templates, making it a truly universal search solution.

✨ Features

  • 🔍 Instant AJAX-powered search
  • 🎯 Keyword highlighting using <mark>
  • 📄 Custom search result templates (Grid / List)
  • 🛍 WooCommerce product search (title + short description)
  • 🧱 Gutenberg Template & Template Part search (FSE)
  • 🗂 Search across all public post types and taxonomies
  • 📌 AJAX-powered Load More button
  • 🎨 Full design customization:
    • Font color
    • Button color
    • Button text color
    • Button hover text color
    • Result background color
  • 🧩 Shortcode support
  • 🛡 Clean and secure code following WordPress standards
  • ⚡ Loads only one CSS and one JS file for maximum performance

🧠 Gutenberg Template Search (FSE)

Dynamic Data Search can include content from:

  • Site Editor → Templates (wp_template)
  • Template Parts (wp_template_part)

This is especially useful for Full Site Editing (FSE) themes, where important site content exists inside templates rather than pages.

🔧 Shortcode Usage

Add the search box anywhere using: [ddsp_data_search]

You can place this shortcode in posts, pages, widgets, or theme templates.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/dynamic-data-search/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → Dynamic Data Search
  4. Configure:
    • Post types
    • Taxonomies
    • Layout (Grid/List)
    • Design colors
    • Gutenberg template search
  5. Add the shortcode [ddsp_data_search] or use the default WordPress search (/?s=keyword)
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support WooCommerce?

Yes, it supports searching WooCommerce products by title and short description.

Does it work with Full Site Editing (FSE) themes?

Yes. It can search Gutenberg Templates and Template Parts.

Can I customize the design?

Yes, you can customize colors and layout directly from the settings page.

Is this plugin lightweight?

Absolutely. It loads only one CSS file and one JS file.
